details: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded a net inflow of $85.8 million on Friday, halting a five-day period of outflows. This reversal suggests a potential shift in short-term investor sentiment, with some buyers re-entering the market. Conversely, spot Ethereum ETFs continued to experience net outflows, indicating a divergence in institutional interest between the two largest cryptocurrencies.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs End Five-Day Outflow Streak

details: Following its historic Nasdaq IPO, SpaceX has officially joined the ranks of major corporate Bitcoin holders, revealing a treasury of 18,712 BTC. MicroStrategy CEO Michael Saylor expanded the "Magnificent Seven" to "Mag8," highlighting that 25% of these elite technology companies, including SpaceX and Tesla, now hold Bitcoin on their balance sheets. This move further underscores growing institutional adoption of Bitcoin.
title: SpaceX Joins "Mag8" with 18,712 BTC, Says Michael Saylor

details: The U.S. government issued an export-control order mandating Anthropic to disable its new Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models for foreign national users due to national security concerns. This action has reportedly led to a surge in interest and prices for decentralized AI-related crypto tokens like Venice (VVV) and Morpheus (MOR), as investors seek alternatives to centralized AI infrastructure susceptible to government intervention.
title: US Anthropic AI Ban Fuels Decentralized AI Crypto Tokens

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved NYSE Arca's proposal to list and trade shares of the T. Rowe Price Active Crypto ETF. This actively managed fund will offer investors exposure to a diversified basket of digital assets, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), XRP, Solana (SOL), Dogecoin (DOGE), and Shiba Inu (SHIB), marking a significant advancement for institutional involvement in multi-asset crypto products.
title: SEC Approves T. Rowe Price Active Crypto ETF with BTC, ETH, XRP

details: Public crypto token sales (Initial Coin Offerings, Initial DEX Offerings, and Initial Exchange Offerings) are reportedly on track for their weakest quarterly fundraising result in five years. In Q2 2026, only $58 million has been raised so far, representing an 85% drop from the previous quarter. May 2026 recorded the lowest monthly sales count since December 2020, signaling a sharp decline in capital flowing into new projects and increased investor caution.
title: Crypto Public Token Sales Heading for 5-Year Low in Q2 2026
